rules.detects: SUBMIT ... AND RETURN inside a RAP handler/saver (bypasses RAP transactional buffer)

rules.name: detect_screen_call_in_handler (ABAP-PERF-77)
rules.detects: CALL SCREEN / SET SCREEN / CALL DIALOG / CALL TRANSACTION / MESSAGE-with-UI inside a RAP handler/saver (RAP has no Dynpro session)

rules.name: detect_modify_in_read_handler (ABAP-PERF-78)
rules.detects: EML MODIFY ENTITIES inside a FOR READ handler (read path mutates buffer state)

rules.name: detect_update_task_in_late_save (ABAP-PERF-79)
rules.detects: CALL FUNCTION ... IN UPDATE TASK inside the late RAP save/adjust_numbers phase (queues work past LUW boundary)

rules.name: detect_bg_unit_in_late_save (ABAP-PERF-80)
rules.detects: CALL FUNCTION ... IN BACKGROUND UNIT inside the late RAP save phase (bgRFC binds to wrong LUW)

rules.name: detect_cds_too_many_tables (ABAP-PERF-81)
rules.detects: CDS view entity joining >100 distinct underlying tables (HANA plan-stability collapse)

rules.name: detect_cds_service_quality_a_too_many (ABAP-PERF-82)
rules.detects: @ObjectModel serviceQuality:A CDS view with >3 underlying tables (breaks A plan-stability budget)

rules.name: detect_cds_service_quality_b_too_many (ABAP-PERF-83)
rules.detects: @ObjectModel serviceQuality:B CDS view with >5 underlying tables (breaks B plan-stability budget)

rules.name: detect_cds_missing_usage_type (ABAP-PERF-84)
rules.detects: Non-private CDS view missing @ObjectModel.usageType serviceQuality/sizeCategory/dataClass annotations

rules.name: detect_cds_left_outer_no_many_to_one (ABAP-PERF-85)
rules.detects: LEFT OUTER JOIN in a CDS view without a MANY TO ONE cardinality qualifier (HANA cannot prune join)

rules.name: detect_cds_calc_field_in_where (ABAP-PERF-86)
rules.detects: Calculated CDS field (concat/case/cast/coalesce/substring) referenced in the WHERE clause (blocks filter push-down)

rules.name: detect_cds_calc_field_in_join (ABAP-PERF-87)
rules.detects: Calculated CDS field used in a JOIN ON condition (blocks predicate push-down)

rules.name: detect_cds_case_else_constant (ABAP-PERF-88)
rules.detects: CASE...ELSE <constant>...END in a CDS view is not NULL-preserving (blocks CASE/LEFT-OUTER-JOIN swap)

rules.name: detect_cds_constant_in_join (ABAP-PERF-89)
rules.detects: Literal constant (=/<>) in a CDS JOIN ON clause (triggers engine switch + materialisation)

rules.name: detect_cds_cyclic_join (ABAP-PERF-90)
rules.detects: Same table appears >=3 times across FROM+JOIN clauses (cyclic-looking CDS join graph)

rules.name: detect_cds_non_equi_join (ABAP-PERF-91)
rules.detects: Non-equi CDS JOIN (BETWEEN, LIKE, <, >, <=, >= in ON) forcing engine switch/materialisation

rules.name: detect_cds_group_by_in_interface (ABAP-PERF-92)
rules.detects: GROUP BY in an interface/reused CDS view (I_ prefix or @VDM.viewType BASIC/COMPOSITE) forcing per-consumer materialisation

rules.name: detect_cds_calc_field_right_of_left_outer (ABAP-PERF-93)
rules.detects: CDS view exposes a calculated field AND contains a LEFT OUTER JOIN (optimiser cannot push filters through)

rules.name: detect_cds_aggregation_wraps_function (ABAP-PERF-94)
rules.detects: Aggregate wrapping a per-row function: SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX(ROUND/CONVERT_CURRENCY/CAST/COALESCE(...))

rules.name: detect_cds_calc_field_in_interface (ABAP-PERF-95)
rules.detects: Interface CDS view (I_ prefix or @VDM.viewType BASIC/COMPOSITE) defines a calculated field

rules.name: detect_limit_without_filter (ABAP-PERF-96)
rules.detects: SELECT ... UP TO N ROWS / SELECT SINGLE without a selective (=) WHERE clause (LIMIT applied late, no cost reduction)

rules.name: ABAP-N1 (detect_n1_queries)
rules.detects: SELECT / SELECT SINGLE statement executed inside a LOOP AT ... ENDLOOP block (N+1 database round-trip anti-pattern)

rules.name: ABAP-OB1 (detect_missing_order_by)
rules.detects: SELECT ... INTO TABLE without an ORDER BY clause (implicit sort order not guaranteed on HANA)

rules.name: S4-001
rules.detects: Direct SELECT ... FROM classic transparent table T001 / T005 / MARA (should use CDS view entity)

rules.name: S4-002
rules.detects: BAPI_* CALL FUNCTION inside an ENHANCEMENT (migrate to RAP Action + EML)

rules.name: S4-003
rules.detects: Classic list output statements WRITE: / FORMAT COLOR (no runtime in S/4HANA Cloud; migrate to ALV/Fiori)

rules.name: S4-004
rules.detects: Dynpro screen flow SET SCREEN / CALL SCREEN (Dynpro runtime absent in S/4HANA Cloud; migrate to Fiori Elements)

rules.name: S4-005
rules.detects: Web Dynpro interface usage (IF_WD_* / WD_* identifiers) — WDYN sunset in S/4HANA 2027

rules.name: S4-006
rules.detects: Direct FROM T001 / T005 / T006 table access (use released CDS views I_CompanyCode / I_UoM)

rules.name: _DEPRECATED_API_PATTERN (compute_s4_readiness legacy regex)
rules.detects: CALL FUNCTION to deprecated FMs (CONVERSION_EXIT_*, NUMBER_GET_NEXT, POPUP_TO_CONFIRM, RS_COVERPAGE_*, REUSE_ALV_GRID_DISPLAY*)

rules.name: _DEPRECATED_TABLES regex (BSIS/BSAS FROM)
rules.detects: SELECT FROM deprecated FI secondary-index tables BSIS / BSAS (replaced by ACDOCA in S/4HANA)

rules.name: Cloudification registry table lookup (compute_s4_readiness)
rules.detects: Table reference whose SAP Cloudification-registry state is deprecated / notToBeReleased (with released-successor lookup)

rules.name: Cloudification registry FM lookup (compute_s4_readiness)
rules.detects: CALL FUNCTION whose SAP Cloudification-registry state is deprecated / notToBeReleased (unreleased function module)

rules.name: Cloudification registry class lookup (compute_s4_readiness)
rules.detects: CL_* class reference (CREATE OBJECT / TYPE REF TO / =>) whose registry state is deprecated / notToBeReleased

rules.name: Cloudification classicAPI classification (compute_s4_readiness)
rules.detects: CL_* class classified as classicAPI (Clean Core Level B/C rather than released Level A API)

rules.name: compute_semantic_metrics (cyclomatic/nesting/dynamic-call/unused-var/comment ratios)
rules.detects: Per-file metrics: cyclomatic complexity (IF/ELSEIF/CASE/WHEN/LOOP/DO/WHILE count), max nesting depth, dynamic vs static CALL FUNCTION ratio, unused DATA declaration ratio, comment ratio, statement count — thresholds later feed migration_complexity/effort scoring, no standalone finding

rules.name: classify_namespace / compute_namespace_summary
rules.detects: Classifies objects as customer (Z*/Y*/ /ns/ /#ns#) vs sap_standard and flags mixed-namespace scan — scoping metadata, not an anti-pattern finding

rules.name: extract_authority_checks
rules.detects: Extracts AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT statements with ID/FIELD pairs into auth_object boundary nodes — graph enrichment, does not itself flag missing checks

rules.name: resolve_select_tables / _parse_select_columns
rules.detects: Builds uses_table edges (table names + referenced columns) from SELECT/INSERT/MODIFY/DELETE/UPDATE — graph infrastructure, no finding

rules.name: enrich_node_metadata (migration_complexity / effort_tier / modernization_target)
rules.detects: Derives SAP module, modernization target (RAP/Fiori/CDS by object type), effort tier, priority rank, and a 0-5 migration_complexity score from thresholds on dynamic-call ratio, cyclomatic, nesting, debt, and legacy object type

rules.name: compute_compound_debt (three-pillar score)
rules.detects: Aggregates Clarity/Stability/Performance compound debt score from comment ratio, S4-* hit count, ABAP-N1/OB1 hits, and dynamic-call ratio — scoring rollup, not a discrete finding

rules.name: detect_endselect_no_package_size (ABAP-PERF-56)
rules.detects: SELECT ... ENDSELECT loop with no PACKAGE SIZE (single-row DB round-trips).

rules.name: detect_slow_value_pass (ABAP-PERF-57)
rules.detects: IMPORTING VALUE(param) that is never mutated — pass-by-value copy cost.

rules.name: detect_select_single_partial_key (ABAP-PERF-58)
rules.detects: SELECT SINGLE whose WHERE clause does not constrain the full primary key.

rules.name: detect_cds_field_order (ABAP-PERF-61)
rules.detects: CDS view with a key field after a non-key field, or a regular field after an association.

rules.name: detect_sql_host_type_mismatch (ABAP-PERF-62)
rules.detects: WHERE compares a char-suffixed column (_id/_key/_code/_nr/_text) to a bare numeric literal — implicit type-cast cost.

rules.name: detect_default_key (ABAP-PERF-63)
rules.detects: Internal table declared WITH DEFAULT KEY (implicit key composition).

rules.name: detect_append_vs_insert (ABAP-PERF-64)
rules.detects: Standalone APPEND (outside a LOOP) where INSERT INTO TABLE would be table-type-agnostic.

rules.name: detect_read_table_existence (ABAP-PERF-65)
rules.detects: READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS used for an existence check instead of line_exists().

rules.name: detect_whole_table_modify_in_loop (ABAP-PERF-66)
rules.detects: Whole-table SORT / DELETE ... WHERE / MODIFY ... TRANSPORTING inside a LOOP body.

rules.name: detect_business_logic_in_cds (ABAP-PERF-67)
rules.detects: CDS projection carrying >=3 CASE expressions — business logic pushed into the data layer.

rules.name: detect_upper_cds_direct_ddic (ABAP-PERF-68)
rules.detects: Composite/consumption/transactional CDS view selecting directly from a DDIC table instead of a Basic (I_*/A_*) view.

rules.name: detect_db_write_in_loop (ABAP-PERF-69)
rules.detects: DB INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MODIFY (non-EML, non-itab) inside a LOOP — per-row write round-trips.

rules.name: detect_draft_action_no_optimized (ABAP-PERF-70)
rules.detects: BDEF draft action declared without the 'optimized' addition.

rules.name: detect_direct_child_create_in_draft (ABAP-PERF-71)
rules.detects: Draft-enabled child entity behavior declaring direct 'create;' instead of deep create via the parent (cba).

rules.name: detect_eml_local_mode_outside_test (ABAP-PERF-73)
rules.detects: EML MODIFY/READ ENTITIES ... IN LOCAL MODE outside a FOR TESTING class — authorization bypass.

rules.name: detect_unbounded_rap_read_list (ABAP-PERF-10)
rules.detects: RAP read-list/get_entity_set/read_entities method with no TOP/SKIP/paging bound.

rules.name: detect_sync_db_in_rap_loop (ABAP-PERF-11)
rules.detects: MODIFY ENTITIES / EXECUTE WRITE inside a per-row LOOP — defeats RAP batching.

rules.name: detect_rap_missing_initial_guard (ABAP-PERF-12)
rules.detects: MODIFY ENTITIES OF ... FIELDS with no IS NOT INITIAL / LINES() short-circuit guard on the input.

rules.name: detect_rap_early_numbering (ABAP-PERF-40)
rules.detects: RAP BDEF declares 'numbering :: early' on a create-heavy entity (should be late).

rules.name: detect_rap_deep_create_unbounded (ABAP-PERF-41)
rules.detects: RAP deep-create create(cba::child) with no nearby cardinality cap (max:).

rules.name: detect_rap_mixed_managed_unmanaged (ABAP-PERF-42)
rules.detects: Same BDEF declares both 'managed implementation' and 'unmanaged implementation'.

rules.name: detect_odata_no_paging_policy (ABAP-PERF-21)
rules.detects: Service binding (SRVB) exposes an entity set with no paging / $top / max-page-size policy.

rules.name: detect_expand_high_cardinality (ABAP-PERF-22)
rules.detects: $expand-able association / composition [0..*] in CDS with no maxItems cardinality cap.

rules.name: detect_draft_no_optimistic_lock (ABAP-PERF-23)
rules.detects: Draft-enabled CDS/BDEF entity with no optimistic locking mode / ETag (systemDate.lastChangedAt).

rules.name: detect_missing_analytical_annotation (ABAP-PERF-24)
rules.detects: Analytical Fiori consumer (AnalyticalListPage/@UI.headerInfo) CDS view lacking @Analytics.dataCategory/dataExtraction.

rules.name: detect_high_cost_virtual_element (ABAP-PERF-25)
rules.detects: @ObjectModel.virtualElement in CDS — per-row fetch-time calc that breaks server-side filtering.

rules.name: detect_skip_pagination_large_set (ABAP-PERF-30)
rules.detects: Service binding uses $skip-style paging instead of cursor-based $skiptoken on a large set.

rules.name: detect_filter_not_delegated (ABAP-PERF-31)
rules.detects: Custom OData provider get_entityset method with no WHERE/SADL pushdown — $filter handled in ABAP.

rules.name: detect_long_lock_duration (ABAP-PERF-32)
rules.detects: Pessimistic draft lock (BDEF) with no @Locking.timeoutSeconds.

rules.name: detect_enqueue_no_timeout (ABAP-PERF-33)
rules.detects: CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_*' with no _WAIT parameter — unbounded lock wait / dispatcher hang.

rules.name: detect_lock_spans_long_work (ABAP-PERF-34)
rules.detects: ENQUEUE_* lock held across an unrelated CALL FUNCTION before the DEQUEUE_*.

rules.name: detect_standard_for_keyed_lookup (ABAP-PERF-06)
rules.detects: READ TABLE ... WITH KEY against a STANDARD internal table (linear keyed lookup); suggests HASHED/SORTED.

rules.name: detect_sorted_for_sequential_scan (ABAP-PERF-07)
rules.detects: SORTED/HASHED table only ever scanned sequentially (LOOP AT without WHERE/USING KEY); suggests STANDARD.

rules.name: detect_internal_table_copy_on_assign (ABAP-PERF-08)
rules.detects: LOOP AT ... INTO work-area copies each row by value instead of ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL/REFERENCE INTO.

rules.name: detect_append_in_tight_loop (ABAP-PERF-09)
rules.detects: APPEND inside a LOOP with no nearby TYPE STANDARD TABLE guard (append-cost heuristic).

rules.name: detect_repeated_config_read_in_loop (ABAP-PERF-19)
rules.detects: SELECT from a config table (T*/V_*/TVAR*) inside a LOOP; hoist read out of loop.

rules.name: detect_clear_vs_refresh_discipline (ABAP-PERF-20)
rules.detects: CLEAR on a table-typed variable inside a loop where REFRESH would preserve capacity.

rules.name: detect_collect_into_standard (ABAP-PERF-37)
rules.detects: COLLECT into a STANDARD table (O(n) per insert); suggests HASHED with UNIQUE KEY.

rules.name: detect_loop_where_no_secondary_key (ABAP-PERF-38)
rules.detects: LOOP AT ... WHERE on a STANDARD table with no SECONDARY KEY (full scan per outer iteration).

rules.name: detect_excessive_secondary_keys (ABAP-PERF-39)
rules.detects: Internal table declares more than 3 SECONDARY KEYs (write cost scales with key count).

rules.name: detect_free_in_loop (ABAP-PERF-45)
rules.detects: FREE on an internal table inside a hot loop deallocates capacity each iteration; use REFRESH.

rules.name: detect_dynamic_field_symbol_in_loop (ABAP-PERF-46)
rules.detects: ASSIGN COMPONENT inside a tight loop causing per-iteration RTTI lookup.

rules.name: detect_select_star_unused (ABAP-PERF-01)
rules.detects: SELECT * (or SELECT SINGLE *) fetching all columns where a projection would suffice.

rules.name: detect_aggregation_in_loop (ABAP-PERF-02)
rules.detects: SUM/COUNT/GROUP BY computed in an ABAP LOOP instead of pushed to a CDS view.

rules.name: detect_client_sort (ABAP-PERF-03)
rules.detects: Client-side SORT after a SELECT lacking ORDER BY (could sort/DISTINCT at DB).

rules.name: detect_cds_join_candidate (ABAP-PERF-04)
rules.detects: 3+ SELECT ... FROM statements in one source that should be one CDS view join.

rules.name: detect_amdp_candidate (ABAP-PERF-05)
rules.detects: Complex per-row calculation (CASE/COND/IF-ELSEIF) in a loop; AMDP/table-function candidate.

rules.name: detect_missing_cds_buffering (ABAP-PERF-26)
rules.detects: CDS DDL define view without @AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory / buffering directive.

rules.name: detect_ddic_type_cast (ABAP-PERF-27)
rules.detects: CDS cast to DDIC primitive (abap.char/numc/dec/int4/int8) losing semantic annotations.

rules.name: detect_currency_no_ref (ABAP-PERF-28)
rules.detects: CDS @Semantics.amount.currencyCode/quantity.unitOfMeasure field with no reference association.

rules.name: detect_authority_filter_after_fetch (ABAP-PERF-29)
rules.detects: CDS @AccessControl.authorizationCheck:#CHECK with no DCL/#PRIVILEGED_ONLY pushdown (app-side filter).

rules.name: detect_scalar_function_in_loop (ABAP-PERF-35)
rules.detects: HANA scalar function (currency/unit/fiscal/CONVERT_*) called per-row via CALL FUNCTION in a loop.

rules.name: detect_window_function_candidate (ABAP-PERF-36)
rules.detects: ABAP loop computing rank/row_number/running-total/previous-row (SQL window-function candidate).

rules.name: detect_fae_missing_initial_guard (ABAP-PERF-13)
rules.detects: SELECT ... FOR ALL ENTRIES with no preceding IS NOT INITIAL / LINES()>0 guard on the driver (empty driver = full scan).

rules.name: detect_fae_no_pk_prefix (ABAP-PERF-14)
rules.detects: FOR ALL ENTRIES WHERE clause leads with a non-primary-key field (index-prefix misalignment).

rules.name: detect_set_based_regression (ABAP-PERF-15)
rules.detects: SELECT (SINGLE) from a known transaction table (MARA/VBAK/EKKO/BSEG...) inside a LOOP; set-based read regression.

rules.name: detect_sync_http_in_loop (ABAP-PERF-16)
rules.detects: Synchronous cl_http_client send/receive/execute inside a LOOP; move to async/batch.

rules.name: detect_sync_event_mesh (ABAP-PERF-17)
rules.detects: Synchronous cl_em_client/cl_event_mesh send/publish (no 'async' nearby).

rules.name: detect_bgrfc_missing (ABAP-PERF-18)
rules.detects: CALL FUNCTION ... DESTINATION without bgRFC unit scheduling nearby (no retry/persistence).

rules.name: detect_direct_http_url (ABAP-PERF-43)
rules.detects: cl_http_client_factory=>create_by_url bypassing the BTP Destination service.

rules.name: detect_comm_arrangement_missing (ABAP-PERF-44)
rules.detects: cl_http_destination_provider=>create_by_url instead of create_by_comm_arrangement.

rules.name: run_abap_performance_detectors / register_detector / dispatcher (abap_performance.py)
rules.detects: Dispatcher + registry only (domain filtering, sub-module import, per-detector try/except). No standalone check.

rules.name: SEC-001
rules.detects: EXEC SQL ... ENDEXEC block containing the && concat operator (dynamic Native SQL = SQL injection)

rules.name: SEC-002
rules.detects: OPEN DATASET with a non-literal (variable) path — path-traversal vector

rules.name: SEC-003
rules.detects: INSERT REPORT / GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL — dynamic ABAP source generation (RCE)

rules.name: SEC-004
rules.detects: CALL TRANSACTION with a variable t-code (unquoted) — bypasses static S_TCODE/SU24 auth

rules.name: SEC-005
rules.detects: Hardcoded credential literal (password/api_key/secret/token/bearer = '...'), excluding placeholders

rules.name: SEC-006
rules.detects: cl_abap_browser=>show_html( ) called with && string concatenation — XSS

rules.name: SEC-007
rules.detects: Direct kernel call CALL 'SYSTEM' / CALL 'C_*' — bypasses ABAP authority concept, forbidden in Cloud

rules.name: SEC-008
rules.detects: AUTHORITY-CHECK with no sy-subrc test within 6 following lines — decorative auth gate (P4 invariant)

rules.name: SEC-009
rules.detects: CALL FUNCTION ... DESTINATION with a variable (unquoted) destination — RFC routing controlled by data

rules.name: SEC-010
rules.detects: HTTP Location header (set_header_field) set from a non-literal value — open-redirect

rules.name: HARDY-02 (detect_copy_paste)
rules.detects: Duplicate sequence of >=6 identical (stripped) source lines within a file

rules.name: HARDY-03 (detect_scope_surprise)
rules.detects: DATA declared inside an IF/LOOP/DO/WHILE/CASE block (misleading — ABAP gives it method/file-wide scope)

rules.name: HARDY-04 (detect_deprecated_tables)
rules.detects: SELECT ... FROM a deprecated FI/SD table (BSIS/BSAS/BSID/BSAD/BSIK/BSAK/KONV/VBFA) removed in S/4HANA

rules.name: HARDY-06 (detect_field_symbol_persistence)
rules.detects: ASSIGN followed by an sy-subrc check within 5 lines but no UNASSIGN — stale field-symbol on failure path

rules.name: HARDY-07 (detect_type_mismatch_initial)
rules.detects:
IF

IS INITIAL where

is an IMPORTING parameter — possible type-compatibility surprise

rules.name: HARDY-08 (detect_contradiction)
rules.detects: READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS then work-area component access (wa-field) in next 3 lines

rules.name: HARDY-09 (detect_hardcoded_dependency)
rules.detects: NEW/CREATE OBJECT of a custom class (z*/y*//ns/) — hardcoded dependency, no factory/DI

rules.name: HARDY-10 (detect_test_coverage_gap)
rules.detects: File with >=2 public METHODS declarations and no FOR TESTING class present

rules.name: HARDY-11 (detect_buffering_antipattern)
rules.detects: Identical SELECT SINGLE statement repeated >=3 times in a file without caching

rules.name: HARDY-12 (detect_alv_scope_creep)
rules.detects: ALV USER_COMMAND handler block exceeding 30 non-comment lines — extract validation logic

rules.name: CLOUD-031 (_detect_cloud_031_internal_api)
rules.detects: Reference to an SAP-internal-marked API by naming convention: cl_*_internal*, if_*_internal*, sap_*_internal*, or /ns/cl_*_internal* class/interface/FM names.

rules.name: CLOUD-032 (_detect_cloud_032_ddic_table_read)
rules.detects: SELECT / READ TABLE ... FROM a SAP-namespace DDIC table (name not starting Z/Y/Q or /ns/, and not a released I_/C_/P_ CDS view alias) — direct DDIC read instead of released CDS view.

rules.name: CLOUD-033 (_detect_sfw_probe / extract_sfw_probes)
rules.detects: Any Switch Framework state-probe in ABAP: cl_sfw_bf_status_check=>is_active(), cl_fdt_environment=>is_business_function_active(), CALL FUNCTION 'SFW_BF_GET_BFS', or SELECT FROM sfw_bf_users_new — forbidden in ABAP Cloud where BF state is fixed per release.

rules.name: CLOUD-034 (_detect_business_function_deprecated_ref)
rules.detects: CALL FUNCTION 'FM' or SELECT/JOIN FROM table whose owning business function is classified ALWAYS_OFF / NOT_PERMITTED / DEPRECATED for the target S/4 release via BusinessFunctionRegistry cross-walk.
